integrity.proof_type: self-contained analytic derivation plus cited general comparison

scientific_limitations: The root lattice is unscaled and the claimed new range is n >= 5; lower ranks have known special cases.
Explicit permutation spheres are circumspheres, not generally minimum enclosing spheres.
Only one optimal common frame is exhibited; all optimal frames are not classified.
Related earlier work accessible only through abstracts leaves residual historical-priority risk.
title: The type-A root lattice has an optimal Euclidean Kuhn packet in every dimension
